suite_name: DuoMath retrieval golden set (R0 baseline, R2 expectation model)
description: Queries with what a correct retriever should surface. Written for backend/tests/eval_rag.py, which scores Recall@k / MRR / nDCG / latency offline, in either sparse (R0) or hybrid (R2) mode.
notes: expected_ids refer to backend/data/math_problems.jsonl (p1..p6) when expected_source is 'examples'.
expected_ids refer to node ids in backend/data/math_concepts.json when expected_source is 'concepts'.
expect=must_find   -> scored for recall against expected_ids.
expect=no_examples -> on-topic but absent from the worked-example bank: returning ANY worked example is a false positive; concepts are correct, and expected_ids names the ones that should appear.
expect=nothing     -> off-topic: returning anything at all is a false positive.

Version 2.0 splits v1's single 'control' kind in two, because a multi-source retriever makes them different obligations. Q15 asks about an integral of sin^2 x: the concept graph legitimately covers it (Tich phan, Ham so luong giac) even though no worked example does. v1 scored that as a false positive; v2 scores it as what it is - correct concept recall with zero EXAMPLE recall. The example-level false positives R2 removes (Q14->p3, Q15->p4) are unaffected by the reclassification.
